board.evidence: offline replay of saved captures; not new live prices or as-issued historical model forecasts

decisions: Regular season is the primary population; completed 2015-2025 games only, final scores include overtime. Missing line rows excluded per target.
nflverse spread_line is positive for a favored home team; residual is home_score-away_score-spread_line. Inference uses negative home handicap for favored home team.

Historical half-point lines cannot produce exclusively integer exact residuals. Preserve exact residual counts; additionally quantize residuals to nearest integer, halves away from zero. No smoothing or centering. This representation choice is explicit, not claimed to preserve half-point locations.

At inference round the consensus center to the nearest integer (halves away from zero), translate the integer histogram; clamp impossible negative total support to zero, preserving unit mass. This is an approximate integer location model, not a conditional key-number model.
Fair probabilities for two-way wager pricing are conditional on no push; unconditional win and push probabilities are separate columns. Three-way moneylines retain tie mass.
Player props cannot be modeled from game margins/totals; model fields remain blank with UNSUPPORTED_PLAYER_PROP and consensus filtering retained.
Wong flags apply to the offered side handicap; ticket joint probabilities are not inferred from marginal legs.
Consensus fair line uses existing closest-offered-to-50pct method; no new line interpolation or data calls.

CLV is American cents against power-devigged executed-book closing probability at the exact approved line, last quote within ten minutes before kickoff and after approval. Missing close is unavailable; no different-book substitution.
Grading only accepts T60 label with pre-cutoff inputs/freeze, matching frozen pick quote and pinned model code/artifact; final results required. Training-period grades rejected.
